# Khalid Alharbi

> Electrical and computer engineering student at King Abdulaziz University (Jeddah, Saudi Arabia), working toward AI software engineering. Completed the KAUST Academy AI Specialization (Nov 2025 to Feb 2026).

The site has one page in two languages: English at https://khalidt-alharbi.github.io/ and Arabic at https://khalidt-alharbi.github.io/ar/

## Projects

- OnKith (KAUST Academy, team of six, 2026): privacy-first voice assistant on a Raspberry Pi 5 that masks personal information on-device. Website: https://onkith.online/ . Khalid's role: training data. He built a Saudi and MENA entity generator after the PII detector kept missing Saudi names, and assembled and published the 284,619-row training corpus. Repository: https://github.com/YahyaAlsharif/OnKith . Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/KhalidAlharbi377/pii-detection-multisource-en-saudi-arabic
- HI-BSDS (KAU engineering design, team of six, 2026): helmet-mounted blind spot warning system for motorcycle riders using ESP32 boards, 24 GHz mmWave radar and time-of-flight LiDAR. Khalid's role: firmware for all three boards.
- Temperature-controlled cooling system (KAU, 2025): Peltier-module cooling for enclosed spaces. Khalid's role: hardware and control logic lead.
